color.light.description: The name of a color token's value in the light color scheme, in the theme editor: over its swatch and its #rrggbb field.

color.dark.description: The name of a color token's value in the dark color scheme, in the theme editor: over its swatch and its #rrggbb field.

color.pick.description: The name of a color swatch in the theme editor that opens the system's color picker, for the light or the dark value of a token (read with Light or Dark).

color.meets.description: Read by a screen reader alone before a contrast pair's ratio in the theme editor, when the pair meets the minimum of WCAG 2 level AA; parallel to color.below.

color.below.description: Read by a screen reader alone before a contrast pair's ratio in the theme editor, when the pair is under the minimum of WCAG 2 level AA (an error that keeps the theme from being saved); parallel to color.meets.

color.format.defaultMessage: Enter a color as # and 6 characters from 0 to 9 and a to f, such as #ff6b6b.
color.format.description: The error under a color's field in the theme editor when what was typed is no color: the field takes # and six hexadecimal digits (0 to 9, a to f).

color.ratio.description: A contrast pair's ratio in the theme editor when it meets its minimum, after a check mark (4.62:1); the minimum is said once for the field (color.needs).

color.short.description: A contrast pair's ratio in the theme editor when it is under its minimum, after an error mark: ratio is the pair's contrast (2.77), minimum what it needs (4.5 for text, 3 for a mark).

color.needs.defaultMessage: {kinds, select, one {Each pair needs {high}:1 or more (WCAG AA).} other {Text needs {high}:1 or more, a mark {low}:1 (WCAG AA).}}
color.needs.description: Under a color token's name in the theme editor: the contrast its pairs need, once for the field (one minimum for all, or text's and a mark's).
